headline_original: Volume of retail trade down by 0.6% in the euro area and by 0.4% in the EU
headline_cs: Maloobchod eurozóny v červenci klesl o 0,6 %
summary_cs: Maloobchodní tržby v eurozóně klesly meziměsíčně o 0,6 % a meziročně vzrostly jen o 0,6 %, pod tržním očekáváním kolem 1,1 %. Slabší spotřebitelská poptávka je mírně negativní pro evropské cyklické akcie.

market_context_at_prediction.notes: Weak euro-area retail data is a modest growth negative, but low VIX and easing US yields limit bearish conviction. Elevated oil remains an additional European growth and margin headwind.

learning_prior.reason: No verified ACTIONABLE context-aware segment in by_context, by_instrument_context, by_category_context or by_instrument_category_context justified a material confidence change. EARLY_SIGNAL evidence was advisory only and INSUFFICIENT segments were not used.

predictions.mechanism: Weaker-than-expected euro-area retail activity points to softer household demand and slower growth, mildly negative for broad euro-area cyclicals.
predictions.invalidation: A strong global risk-on move, falling oil prices or stronger subsequent euro-area data overwhelms the retail-sales signal.

predictions.mechanism: Weak regional consumption offsets part of the earlier positive German factory-orders impulse and is mildly negative for cyclical German equities.
predictions.invalidation: German-specific strength or global risk-on conditions dominate the weak regional consumption print.

predictions.mechanism: Softer euro-area consumer demand is a mild negative for consumer-sensitive French equities.
predictions.invalidation: Luxury/consumer names decouple from the macro print or broader global risk appetite strengthens materially.
